current.description: Frozen current full-kit behavior: S1 +4% all damage; S2 every second normal Lancer attack delivers extra15% skill damage and next-turn +5% all-troop Attack.

s2_lancer_only_buff.description: Only S2 Attack buff scope changes to Lancers; S1 and S2 extra attack retain current behavior.

s1_lancer_only_buff.description: Only S1 damage buff scope changes to Lancers; full S2 retains current behavior.

faster_s2_cadence.description: S2 first fires on the second normal Lancer attack, then on every normal Lancer attack. Diagnostic faster-cadence counterfactual; not a general implementation of historical attack-counter rules.

same_turn_s2_buff.description: Only S2 Attack buff delay changes from next turn to current turn, using existing simulator activation and attack ordering.

normal_damage_boost.description: S2 extra skill job becomes a one-use normal-damage modifier of +15 percentage points in the hero damage bucket; not a separately multiplicative 1.15 factor.

s1_attack_bucket.description: Only S1 uses the active hero Attack bucket instead of the active hero damage bucket.

provenance.outcomeExposure: Replay with frozen candidates and supplied input; preserve original prospective prediction. This replay is not itself a game observation.
provenance.stats: Caller supplied report-resolved stats. No hero-generation bonus is added; verify report identity and full input before interpretation.
provenance.kit: WIP Sonya 1/1/0, minxxx no heroes, no joiners, all T6. S3 is locked on this account, not artificially disabled.

uncertainty.note: 290 shared stat vectors: 256 interior, 32 coordinate endpoints, 2 favorable/opposing corners. A sensitivity screen, not an exhaustive bound; no account-state drift allowance.
